rateLimits.note: Asked: "try to keep it to 60 requests per minute or lower"; the API throttles at 100 requests a minute (HTTP 429). The Recommended Practices page says "about 1 per second". Repeated excess may get the IP blocked.
Asked: "keep under 10,000 requests per day" (Recommended Practices: "around 10k API requests a day").

attribution.text: iNaturalist, with each observer and the licence of each observation and photo

rights.licence: Per observation and per photo: CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-NC-4.0 (the default), other CC variants, or all rights reserved

provenance.notes: API documentation (api.inaturalist.org/v1/docs, its swagger description) read live 2026-11-10: "we throttle API usage to a max of 100 requests per minute, though we ask that you try to keep it to 60 requests per minute or lower, and to keep under 10,000 requests per day"; blocks without notice for heavy impact; "intended to support application development, not data scraping". The Recommended Practices and Terms pages answered 403 live and were read in Wayback snapshots (2026-10-16, 2026-10-27): about 1 request a second and around 10k a day, HTTP 429 beyond, IPs that consistently exceed may be blocked, use a single IP (coordinated IPs blocked), more than 5 GB of media an hour or 24 GB a day may bring a permanent block (media hosts, not counted here), a custom User-Agent naming the application is asked for ("please consider"), bulk data through exports or the GBIF dataset (doi:10.15468/ab3s5x). Terms: content licensed CC BY-NC by default unless the contributor chose otherwise; commercial AI training on iNaturalist data is prohibited. Rights depend on each record's licence (license, image_license), so commercial, storage and redistribution are unknown at source level. No rate-limit headers seen on a test call. Legal: legal@inaturalist.org.
